Dwebble

Bug Rock

Unova · Generation 5

Dwebble is a Bug/Rock-type Rock Inn Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 14.5 kg. It evolves into Crustle. Its highest base stat is Defense (85), with a base stat total of 325.
